title: payments-api high 5xx and memory pressure
content: When payments-api shows sustained 5xx errors with memory usage above 90 percent, first verify upstream dependencies. If dependency health is normal and memory remains high, perform a controlled service restart. If symptoms recur within 30 minutes, escalate to the owning team and create an incident ticket.

title: checkout-service latency degradation
content: For checkout-service latency, inspect database connection-pool saturation and downstream dependency latency. Do not restart unless CPU or memory is saturated. Create a ticket if pool saturation persists.
